description: 雅思核心词汇库 - 按优先级轮换（high → medium → low）

words.example: The researcher was meticulous in recording every experimental detail.
words.exampleTranslation: 这位研究员在记录每一个实验细节时都极为严谨。

movieQuote.quote: I've always been meticulous about my work.

words.definition: 无处不在的；普遍存在的
words.example: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern society.
words.exampleTranslation: 智能手机在现代社会中已变得无处不在。

movieQuote.quote: Surveillance is ubiquitous in this city.

words.example: We need a pragmatic approach to solve this complex problem.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们需要一种务实的方法来解决这个复杂问题。

movieQuote.quote: We must be pragmatic about our chances.

words.definition: 有韧性的；能迅速恢复的
words.example: Children are often more resilient than adults when facing setbacks.
words.exampleTranslation: 面对挫折时，儿童往往比成年人更有韧性。

movieQuote.quote: Human beings are remarkably resilient creatures.

words.example: The committee scrutinized every clause of the proposed contract.
words.exampleTranslation: 委员会仔细审查了拟议合同的每一个条款。

movieQuote.quote: They will scrutinize every detail of your story.

words.example: Air quality tends to deteriorate during the winter months.
words.exampleTranslation: 冬季空气质量往往会恶化。

movieQuote.quote: His condition continues to deteriorate.

words.example: The new policy aims to alleviate poverty in rural areas.
words.exampleTranslation: 新政策旨在缓解农村地区的贫困问题。

movieQuote.quote: This medicine will alleviate the pain.

words.example: Both parties reached a compromise after lengthy negotiations.
words.exampleTranslation: 经过漫长的谈判，双方达成了妥协。

movieQuote.quote: We don't compromise on safety.

words.example: There was a discrepancy between the official report and eyewitness accounts.
words.exampleTranslation: 官方报告与目击者陈述之间存在差异。

movieQuote.quote: There's a discrepancy in the financial records.

words.example: Oil prices fluctuated wildly throughout the year.
words.exampleTranslation: 全年油价波动剧烈。

movieQuote.quote: The markets fluctuate, but the principle remains.

words.example: The government implemented new regulations to protect the environment.
words.exampleTranslation: 政府实施了新规以保护环境。

movieQuote.quote: We must implement the plan before dawn.

words.example: Smoking can jeopardize your health and that of those around you.
words.exampleTranslation: 吸烟会危及你及周围人的健康。

movieQuote.quote: Don't jeopardize everything we've built.

words.example: Software development has become a highly lucrative career path.
words.exampleTranslation: 软件开发已成为一条高利润的职业道路。

movieQuote.quote: It's a lucrative offer, but I have conditions.

words.example: Planting trees can help mitigate the effects of climate change.
words.exampleTranslation: 植树有助于缓解气候变化的影响。

movieQuote.quote: We must mitigate the damage before it spreads.

words.example: The notion of working from home was once considered unusual.
words.exampleTranslation: 在家办公的概念曾经被认为是反常的。

movieQuote.quote: The notion of freedom is what we fight for.

words.example: This disease is more prevalent in tropical regions.
words.exampleTranslation: 这种疾病在热带地区更为普遍。

movieQuote.quote: Corruption is prevalent in these parts.

words.example: Constant criticism can undermine a child's self-confidence.
words.exampleTranslation: 持续的批评会削弱孩子的自信心。

movieQuote.quote: They will try to undermine your authority.

words.example: Solar energy is now a viable alternative to fossil fuels.
words.exampleTranslation: 太阳能现在是化石燃料的可行替代品。

movieQuote.quote: Is there a viable alternative?

words.example: The origins of this tradition remain obscure to historians.
words.exampleTranslation: 这一传统的起源对历史学家来说仍然模糊不清。

movieQuote.quote: His motives remain obscure to all of us.

words.example: She was reluctant to share her personal information online.
words.exampleTranslation: 她不情愿在网上分享个人信息。

movieQuote.quote: I'm reluctant to trust anyone in this town.

words.example: Subsequent events proved that his prediction was correct.
words.exampleTranslation: 随后发生的事件证明了他的预测是正确的。

movieQuote.quote: Subsequent events proved me right.

words.definition: 有形的；可触摸的；明确的
words.example: The company needs to produce tangible results to attract investors.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司需要拿出明确的成果来吸引投资者。

movieQuote.quote: We need tangible evidence, not theories.

words.example: The situation is serious enough to warrant immediate action.
words.exampleTranslation: 情况严重到值得立即采取行动。

movieQuote.quote: We have a warrant to search the premises.

words.example: The new farming technique yielded a record harvest this year.
words.exampleTranslation: 新的农业技术今年产出了创纪录的收成。

movieQuote.quote: The road will not yield to your impatience.

words.example: The politician gave an ambiguous answer to the reporter's question.
words.exampleTranslation: 这位政治家对记者的问题给出了模棱两可的回答。

movieQuote.quote: His answer was deliberately ambiguous.

words.example: The positive economic data bolstered investor confidence.
words.exampleTranslation: 积极的经济数据增强了投资者信心。

movieQuote.quote: We must bolster our defenses before nightfall.
movieQuote.movie: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers

words.example: A quiet environment is conducive to effective studying.
words.exampleTranslation: 安静的环境有助于高效学习。

movieQuote.quote: This setting is hardly conducive to clear thinking.

words.example: She gave an eloquent speech that moved the entire audience.
words.exampleTranslation: 她发表了一篇雄辩的演讲，感动了全场观众。

movieQuote.quote: Your silence has been more eloquent than any words.

words.example: We need to determine whether the project is feasible within budget.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们需要确定该项目在预算内是否可行。

movieQuote.quote: We need a feasible plan within 48 hours.

words.example: Paris is the quintessential romantic city in many people's eyes.
words.exampleTranslation: 在许多人眼中，巴黎是典型的浪漫之都。

movieQuote.quote: He is the quintessential English gentleman.

words.example: His gregarious personality made him popular at social gatherings.
words.exampleTranslation: 他爱交际的性格使他在社交场合很受欢迎。

movieQuote.quote: She was always the gregarious one in the family.

words.example: The diligent student completed all assignments ahead of schedule.
words.exampleTranslation: 这位勤奋的学生提前完成了所有作业。

movieQuote.quote: Stay diligent, and the truth will reveal itself.
